scope: Descriptive paired physical pilot; two marked layouts repeated twice.
search: If Tank initially misses the board, selective stays still and reads ROSMASTER; local_scan turns Tank in place toward the surveyed wall and reads only Tank. Both stop sensing at the same deadline.
outcome: After physical STOP, measure the Tank centre relative to the taped target cross and heading relative to its taped axis. A stationary in-tolerance endpoint, valid attempt and no intervention are required. Controller status alone never scores success.
physical_difference_from_simulation: The donor arm remains parked at its independently validated camera pose. Real localization uses lidar and ROSMASTER encoders, with bounded local rotation and the existing DriveTo/STOP loop.
